verdict.rationale: Publishing plain-language filing guidance is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls on nvsos.gov and the ORION portal; none of it describes any explainers or step-by-step guidance, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
